sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is first informant/complainant and the case is of the year 2021.
It is argued that delay in disposal of the said case is causing irreparable loss and hardship to the applicant and as such appropriate direction be issued for disposal of trial in time bound manner.

entities.text: Rajendra Singh Raghav vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned State counsel opposed the prayer made in the present matter by arguing that no such specific reasons have been made out for giving any direction for expediting the trial of the case and as such the application be dismissed.
After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the record, it is evident that the trial is of the year 2021.
The same as per order sheet is going on.
There is no specific reason for expediting the same.

However, the applicant who is complainant/first informant of the case, may file an application for expediting the case before the court concerned within two weeks from today,
which may as per its load of work, diary and pendency of cases, pass appropriate orders on the same within two weeks thereafter.
It is made clear that this Court has not passed any direction for expediting the trial.
The present application is disposed of.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 22.3.2023/Naresh  Rajendra Singh Raghav vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105389437/
